He pressed her roughly, like a devouring beast, wildly plundering every part of her body. After a while, there was movement in the quiet room. His heavy breathing and her subtle gasps mixed together and lingered for a long time before returning to calm. During the whole process, his movements were not gentle, and her reaction was very jerky. He and her never exchanged a word from beginning to end. They were not like a couple, but more like two unrelated strangers. One second ended, and the next second Han Jingnian pulled away from Xia Wan'an's body and turned over to lie aside. The disappearance of the weight on her body made Xia Wan'an frown slightly, but she didn't react much. She seemed to be used to it, and calmly pulled the quilt and wrapped it around her body. Xia Wan'an closed her eyes and lay there for a while. After the fatigue faded, she opened her eyes and turned to look at the man next to her. Han Jingnian lay flat on the bed, breathing heavily, as if he had fallen asleep. It was getting late, but Xia Wan'an looked at Han Jingnian without feeling sleepy at all. Thinking about it carefully, it seemed that she hadn't seen him for almost three months... She remembered that the last time he came home, the winter jasmine flowers downstairs had just bloomed, and now the lotus flowers were blooming in the pond... Frankly speaking, if he hadn't come home once in a while, she sometimes couldn't help but wonder if she really had a husband... Two years ago, he said he could marry her, and then without a wedding, a wedding ring, or the blessings of relatives and friends, he and she went to the Civil Affairs Bureau to register their marriage. The first meeting after marriage was six months after receiving the certificate. One late winter night, just like today, she fell asleep and he suddenly came back. He didn't say anything and fell on the bed to sleep. She was very nervous and uneasy and stayed awake for most of the night. She didn't know if her tossing and turning had disturbed him. Anyway, he suddenly grabbed her and had sex with her without a word of cause and effect. Later, he would come home sometimes once a month, sometimes two months, and sometimes three months or even more. Every time he came back, it was at night, and every time he fell asleep after being intimate with her without saying a word. Every time, it was the next day when she woke up and he had disappeared... So in the past two years, he could count on his fingers the words he had said to her. In fact, Xia Wan'an thought more than once that she wouldn't sleep after he came home. When he woke up, she might be able to say a few words to him, but every time it was the same as tonight, she fell asleep thinking about it. The next day was Saturday, so she didn't have to go to work and the alarm didn't go off. She slept well until she woke up naturally. When she opened her eyes, the sun was shining brightly outside the window and it was almost eleven o'clock at noon. Thinking of him coming back last night, Xia Wan'an's first reaction was to look around. That half of the bed was empty, just like before. He had left without knowing when. If it weren't for the traces of him left on her body, she really suspected that his appearance last night was an illusion of hers... Time passed slowly like water, and it was the end of summer in the blink of an eye. The house of more than 300 square meters looks particularly empty every night. After dinner, Xia said good night and read for an hour. When she went to the restaurant to get water, she accidentally discovered that the house was so quiet that she could hear the echo of her own footsteps.
